author: Cory McCabe
physicalObservations: Battery underglow remained orange while selected pinned chats changed in Codex.
After returning from Battery, a pinned chat actively working retained blue underglow for at least 15 seconds.
With the helper completely stopped, a working chat retained blue for ten seconds.
Read-only polling retained working blue; an idle pinned chat showed a brief white selection light then turned off.
Earlier cooperative handoff build passed an approximately one-minute Battery/layer-1 use check: both stayed correct.
Revised runtime: underglow stayed orange and opaque action keys stayed completely dark while pinned Codex chats changed on the Mac.
With the revised dark-key runtime, returning to layer 1 restored the working chat blue button and blue underglow promptly and kept both correct for 15 seconds.

boundedProtocolTrial.variant: Earlier combined ambient/key-color prototype; final dark-key variant has separate physical observations above.

implementation.matchingChannel: one unused channel for underglow, one unused off-state channel for opaque action keys
implementation.exit: clear own sk/sa flags on both channels, then empty v.oai.rgbcfg to reapply firmware native cache

limits: Physical checks establish the observed colors and handoffs, not an optical brightness curve.
The native logging format is a current coordination dependency.
Polling and log-based yielding do not create an exclusive transport lock.
Busy RPC traffic or connection recovery can delay switching.
White and off matching modes have automated coverage; matching orange and dark opaque keys received the physical checks.

packageLifecycle.note: Verified from a built beta 6 ZIP with a temporary layer. Later documentation updates and the pre-write recovery guard have separate automated validation.
